About the RoleWe’re looking for a Data Engineer with 3+ years of experience to support the build and enhancement of a modern AWS-based data platform. The focus of this role is on developing scalable data pipelines, enabling efficient data ingestion, and supporting ongoing platform improvements.Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain data pipelines on AWS
Develop and manage data ingestion frameworks
Work with Redshift and broader AWS data services
Support ETL/ELT processes and data transformations
Contribute to data platform improvements and migrations
Key Requirements
Must have experience with dbt
Experience with AWS data platform (ideally Redshift)
Solid understanding of ETL/ELT and data ingestion
Strong SQL skills and experience with Python (or similar)
Experience working with large-scale data environments
This role is based in Auckland and requires you to be currently in New Zealand. Applicants with existing NZ work rights are encouraged to apply.Please email any queries in the first instance to alicia@younity.co.nz.We are currently experiencing high volumes of applications, please apply if you have the above experience and call Alicia on 021 197 5740 if you have any questions.
Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in New Zealand?
How many years' experience do you have as a Data Engineer?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have experience with dbt?
What is your expected hourly rate?
